A '''cooling motor''' was a component used in the [[Emperor-4 beam tube]]. Twelve cooling motors were used to protect the weapon's sensitive internal electronics, drawing heat away from them and expelling it out of the [[Beam tube/Legends|beam tube]]. However, the hot air was directed into the face of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] carrying the weapon, making it uncomfortable for the wielder.<ref name="EGWT" />
